why: Monsters from the formula on Hask's Ford (lane/monster-formula; 04 section 6), with its four bodies given roles: the Banded Pikeman a Swarm, the Fordsunk a Brute, the Ledger Wight a Caster (its Hex strikes the whole party) and the Bannerman a Warder (its Rally mends the file). The second role mix on the scale, a Caster and a Warder with real bodies. Paired against the tree (C0, today's monsters, no roles) on the same dice
assumptions: A role on a hand row plays its reach on the scale with or without the switch; with it, the row's numbers are the formula's
Drops, coin a kill and XP stay the rows' own, so the economy moves only through kills an hour
